description: This file contains unit tests for the OnboardingStateStore component, testing its behavior regarding onboarding presentation logic and persistence using UserDefaults.

classes.name: OnboardingStateStoreTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for OnboardingStateStore, using a nested TestDefaults struct to manage UserDefaults instances for testing purposes.

methods.name: shouldPresentWhenFreshAndDisconnected
methods.description: Tests whether the onboarding screen should be presented when app is freshly launched and disconnected from gateway.

methods.name: doesNotPresentWhenConnected
methods.description: Verifies onboarding is not presented when the app is connected.

methods.name: markCompletedPersistsMode
methods.description: Checks that marking onboarding as complete persists the mode and prevents onboarding from presenting.

methods.name: firstRunIntroDefaultsToVisibleThenPersists
methods.description: Ensures the first run intro is visible initially and correctly persists its seen status.

methods.name: resetClearsCompletionAndIntroSeen
methods.description: Validates that resetting the onboarding state clears completion and intro seen flags, causing onboarding to present again.

methods.name: makeDefaults
methods.description: Creates and returns a TestDefaults instance with unique UserDefaults for isolated tests.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the UserDefaults for a given TestDefaults instance by removing its persistent domain.
